task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Navigate to the box stack and pick BOX_TOP, place it temporarily on TEMP_TABLE. Return to pick BOX_MIDDLE, navigate to INSPECTION_TABLE, and place BOX_MIDDLE there. Finally, retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack without the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is initially the topmost object and can be picked first.
TEMP_TABLE and BOX_BOTTOM are valid placement locations within interaction distance after navigation.
The robot starts with no objects held.
Coordinates provided in the world state are accurate for navigation and placement.
